anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: The After wording moved ticket, necessary and fallback as intended: A now follows the successful reread of BILL-12 over the stale email copy, B accepts the change because the hosted index cannot work offline, and E falls back to the step-2 copy when the reread fails. C, D and F keep their preserve picks with the right reasons. The message fact still fails in After, for two reasons. First, E puts four sentences above "Pick one:" because the provenance note ("This rests on the copy read at the start of the run, because the fresh read failed.") is a separate sentence. Second, D renders the message twice: the first menu has no [recommended] tag on any row, then a "Correction to the row above" prose line and a full re-render follow, so D is not one clean message. To fix this, say that the three-sentence limit is hard and that a failed-reread or stale-copy caveat must be folded into the second sentence (for example "...which is what ticket 33, as read at the start of the run, asks for"), never added as a fourth. Also say that the message is rendered exactly once, with [recommended] on row 1 checked before output, and that no correction or re-render is emitted. Keep the pre-message narration that carries the ticket command and the judgment, since it sits outside the message and supports the ticket, fallback and unknown facts without breaking the message shape.
